architecture.context: Native design view consumes one M04-owned document; closing attachment leaves document live.
architecture.hexagonal: Trusted native caller adapter → M03 close input port → derived attachment facade → M04 detach_view(handle) → sole M04 owner
architecture.dependency: UI → Tauri native guard → M03 → M04 input contract; no direct S1/IO access
output_ports: Existing proposed M04.detach_view(handle); exact observation contract still proposed
Restricted trusted current attachment observation at delivery; fixture-only seam
driven_adapters: M04 sole owner double; native implementation NOT RUN
architecture.state_ownership: M04 owns S1 content/history/revision/baselines/writer generation. M03 owns derived binding/candidate/preview/replay-disclosure caches only.
architecture.mutation: Only exact attached-view derived authority revoked after M04 confirmation; no content mutation.
architecture.transaction: Native auth → root validation → trusted binding/owner observation → preflight capacity and fences → M04 detach confirmation → revoke derived attachment/candidate/preview/disclosure. Failure precommit unchanged. Native atomicity and postcommit loss unresolved Owner seam.
architecture.external_boundary: Native identity and M04 remain external dependencies; missing integration fails closed.

contracts.C1: Native main/editor identity and origin and live instance checked before dependency/cache lookup; viewer/remote/replaced native denied.
contracts.C2: M04 sole S1 owner; close detaches derived binding only, never closes document or mutates content/history/revision/baselines/formal IO ACK/material roots.
contracts.C3: Validate complete closed request and expected generation/revision before new detach; M04 observed tuple must match bound document/session/project/root/runtime/native instance.
contracts.C4: On confirmed detach revoke binding candidates/previews and replay disclosure authority; in-flight late completion cannot reactivate attachment or install a UI projection.
contracts.C5: No request_id accepted. Other operation replay records cannot be read/resubmitted through close; no automatic retry or TTL.
contracts.C6: Trusted delivery observation must be current, typed and minted by fixture authority, with active attachment/native liveness and full tuple equality.
contracts.C7: Capacity failure is pre-detach and preserves attachment; tombstones are fixture-derived state, not a second document owner.
contracts.C8: Missing dependency, stale generation/revision, dirty unconfirmed writer or malformed observation leaves all model state unchanged.
